title: 47th Kano International Trade Fair (KITF 2026)
tagline: Repositioning Nigeria's Economy through Industrialization, Innovation and Sustainable Trade Development.
description:
The 47th Kano International Trade Fair (KITF 2026), organized by the Kano Chamber of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (KACCIMA), is the premier commercial gathering in Northern Nigeria. Held at the historic Aminu Dantata Trade Fair Complex on Zoo Road, Kano, this landmark edition convenes manufacturers, agro-allied processors, financial institutions, mining concerns, and regional traders from across West Africa and the Sahel.

Under the theme 'Repositioning Nigeria's Economy Through Industrialization, Innovation and Sustainable Trade Development Strategy,' the fair offers KASCOTE members prime exhibition opportunities, direct B2B matchmaking with national distributors, technology showcases, and high-level investment roundtables. KASCOTE facilitates coordinated member pavilions, logistics support, and public-private sector engagement throughout the multi-week exposition.
location: Aminu Dantata Trade Fair Complex, Kano, Nigeria

title: Trade Expo Indonesia 2026 (41st TEI)
tagline: Southeast Asia's largest B2B export exhibition — opening direct bilateral trade channels between Indonesia and Kano.
description:
Trade Expo Indonesia (TEI 2026), organized by the Ministry of Trade of the Republic of Indonesia, is Southeast Asia's flagship B2B international export exhibition. Staged at the state-of-the-art Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City, Tangerang, the 41st edition gathers over 1,400 premier manufacturers and exporters alongside tens of thousands of international buyers from more than 120 nations.

Building directly upon KASCOTE's successful bilateral engagements with the Indonesian Trade Promotion Centre (ITPC) and the Indonesian Embassy in Abuja, KASCOTE is leading an executive delegation of Kano entrepreneurs, commodity traders, and industrial importers. Key participating zones include Food & Beverages, Fashion & Textiles, Agriculture & Halal Products, Chemical & Pharmaceutical Supplies, and Manufacturing Machinery. Delegates benefit from pre-arranged bilateral business matching (B2B), factory visitations, and preferential procurement agreements.

title: MÜSİAD EXPO 2026 — Trade Mission
tagline: Connecting Kano traders with over 1,000 Turkish and international manufacturers in Istanbul.
description:
MÜSİAD EXPO is one of Eurasia's most influential multi-sector international trade fairs, organized biennially by the Independent Industrialists and Businessmen Association (MÜSİAD) in Istanbul, Turkey. Drawing commercial delegations from over 100 countries, the expo serves as a premier crossroads for Eurasian, Middle Eastern, and African commerce.

KASCOTE delegates participate in high-level B2B matchmaking meetings, the G20 Trade Diplomacy Summit, and sector-specific industrial pavilions encompassing construction materials, agro-machinery, textile production, hardware, plastics, and automotive spare parts. KASCOTE coordinates visa processing assistance, translation services, hotel accommodations, and factory site tours in the industrial corridors of Istanbul and Bursa, empowering Kano merchants to import direct from Turkish manufacturers at competitive factory-gate prices.

title: Canton Fair 2026 (140th Autumn Edition)
tagline: KASCOTE's biannual delegation to the world's largest trade fair in Guangzhou, China.
description:
The 140th Canton Fair (China Import and Export Fair) is the world's largest trade fair, held biannually in Guangzhou. KASCOTE organizes a dedicated delegation of Kano traders and entrepreneurs to participate, discover new suppliers, forge partnerships, and open direct import channels from China's manufacturing heartland.

Members get access to textile, electronics, machinery, agricultural equipment, and commodity sectors all under one roof. KASCOTE facilitates group travel, booth access, B2B matchmaking sessions, and post-trip follow-up with Chinese counterparts. The event occurs across three phases encompassing advanced manufacturing, interior decor, and fashion textiles.

title: Sommet de l'Élevage 2026 — Livestock & Agro Summit
tagline: World's #1 sustainable livestock show in France — modernizing Kano's livestock, meat, and dairy value chains.
description:
The Sommet de l'Élevage is internationally recognized as the world's number one sustainable livestock show, held annually at the Grande Halle d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, France. Spanning over 240,000 m² of exhibition space, the summit features over 1,800 exhibitors, 2,000 elite breeding animals, and attracts more than 120,000 professional visitors from over 100 nations.

KASCOTE's agricultural and agribusiness delegation focuses on modernizing Kano's immense livestock, pastoral, and dairy economy. Delegates explore elite bovine, ovine, and caprine breeding genetics, veterinary technologies, automated dairy milking equipment, meat processing & cold chain logistics, and organic forage solutions. The mission includes curated farm tours across the French agricultural heartland, technical masterclasses, and bilateral partnerships with European agricultural machinery manufacturers.
